zh: 每个人都把球传给固定的下一个人，所以从 1 号出发的持球序列一定在某一刻开始重复，之后就是一个循环。k 可达 10^12，不能一步步模拟。
从 1 号开始沿着 receiver 走，记录每个人第一次拿到球的时刻，直到遇到已经拿过球的人。设他第一次出现在时刻 start，那么时刻 start 之后的持球者以长度 len = 路径长 − start 为周期循环。
把访问顺序存进数组 path。若 k 小于 path 的长度，答案就是 path[k]；否则答案是 path[start + (k − start) mod len]。k 用 64 位整数读入。
en: Everyone passes to a fixed next person, so the sequence of holders starting from friend 1 must eventually repeat and then cycle forever. k can be 10^12, so you cannot simulate step by step.

Walk along receiver from friend 1, recording the time each friend first gets the ball, until you reach a friend who has already held it. If that friend first appeared at time start, then from time start on, the holders repeat with period len = path length - start.
Store the visiting order in an array path. If k is less than the length of path, the answer is path[k]; otherwise it is path[start + (k - start) mod len]. Read k as a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Starting with friend 1, each second the ball is passed to the friend specified by receiver; find who holds the ball after the given number of seconds.

## Proof of correctness
